products.name: Bitcoin Mining Services
products.description: Operation of enterprise-scale Bitcoin mining using specialized ASIC miners, both in self-owned facilities and through hosting agreements, to earn Bitcoin rewards and transaction fees. This is a capital-intensive, physical infrastructure business requiring procurement, deployment, and maintenance of mining hardware and access to reliable, low-cost energy.

products.name: Hashrate Provision Services to Mining Pools
products.description: Provision of hash calculation services to Bitcoin mining pool operators under service agreements, earning a share of block rewards and transaction fees based on contributed hashrate. This is delivered digitally via continuous operation of mining hardware connected to third-party pools.

products.name: Tactical and Broadband Communication Solutions
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sustainment of secure, resilient, and interoperable communication systems including tactical radios, software, waveforms, satellite terminals, ISR and tactical data links, and integrated broadband networks. Delivered as physical hardware and software, often for defense and public safety applications.

products.name: Integrated Vision Solutions
products.description: Design, manufacture, and sustainment of helmet-mounted night vision goggles, weapon-mounted sights, aiming lasers, and range finders. Delivered as advanced optical and electronic devices for military and law enforcement use.

products.name: Public Safety and Professional Communications
products.description: Provision of state-of-the-art communication equipment, systems, and applications for first responders, utilities, and transit agencies. Delivered as physical and digital communication systems for public safety and critical infrastructure.

products.name: Integrated Mission Systems and ISR Platforms
products.description: System design, development, integration, production, modernization, and sustainment of multi-mission ISR, passive sensing, targeting, electronic attack, autonomy, power and communications, networks, and sensors. Delivered as integrated hardware and software platforms for defense and intelligence missions.

products.name: Maritime Systems and Autonomous Vessels
products.description: Design, manufacture, and integration of power, electrical, imaging, communication, and sensor systems for naval platforms, including autonomous surface and undersea vessels. Delivered as physical systems and platforms for naval and maritime operations.

products.name: Targeting and Sensor Systems
products.description: Development and manufacturing of multi-domain, multi-spectral electro-optical and infrared sensor systems, specialty laser and filter glass materials, laser range finders, target designators, and autonomous solutions. Delivered as advanced sensor hardware for ISR and targeting missions.

products.name: Defense Electronics and Space Avionics
products.description: Provision of space communications, space flight avionics, passive surveillance, protected GPS communications, navigation, range-testing solutions, and precision electronic components. Delivered as specialized electronic hardware for defense and space applications.

products.name: Space Systems and Surveillance Networks
products.description: Design, development, integration, production, and sustainment of space-based ISR, position/navigation/timing, weather and climate monitoring, missile defense, and ground-based space surveillance networks. Delivered as complex space and ground systems for government and defense customers.

products.name: Intel and Cyber Solutions
products.description: Provision of situational awareness, optical networks, and advanced wireless solutions for classified intelligence and defense customers. Delivered as digital and networked systems for secure communications and intelligence operations.

products.name: Mission Networks for Air Traffic Management
products.description: Development and delivery of communications and networking solutions for air traffic management. Delivered as integrated network systems for civil and defense aviation sectors.

products.name: Airborne Combat Systems
products.description: Design, development, and integration of sensors, processors, hardened electronics, unmanned aircraft systems, precision weapons, infrared search and tracking, distributed aperture systems, weapons release systems, antennas, and threat warning/countermeasures for airborne, ground, and maritime platforms. Delivered as advanced hardware and integrated systems for combat and defense applications.

products.name: Missile Propulsion and Armament Systems
products.description: Provision of propulsion technologies and armament systems for strategic defense, missile defense, hypersonic, tactical, and fuzing systems. Delivered as manufactured propulsion and armament hardware for missiles and defense platforms.

products.name: Space Propulsion and Power Systems
products.description: Design and manufacture of propulsion and power systems for national security, space, and exploration missions. Delivered as specialized hardware for space vehicles and satellites.

products.name: Safety and Facility Identification and Protection Products
products.description: Manufactured and distributed safety signs, traffic signs, floor-marking tape, pipe markers, labeling systems, spill control products, lockout/tagout devices, personal protection equipment, first aid products, and related software and services. These products are produced through physical manufacturing, printing, and software development, and delivered via distributors, direct sales, and digital channels.

products.name: Product Identification Solutions
products.description: Proprietary materials, printing systems, RFID and barcode scanners, direct part marking, engraving equipment, brand protection labeling, asset tracking labels, and industrial track and trace applications. These are manufactured using precision materials, adhesives, and advanced printing and scanning technologies, and delivered globally through multiple sales channels.

products.name: Wire Identification Products
products.description: Handheld printers, wire markers, sleeves, and tags designed for wire and cable identification. These products are manufactured using specialized materials and printing systems and are distributed through direct and indirect channels.

products.name: Healthcare Identification Products
products.description: Wristbands, labels, printing systems, and related products used in hospitals, laboratories, and healthcare settings for patient tracking and safety. These are produced using specialized materials and printing technologies, and delivered to healthcare providers.

products.name: People Identification Solutions
products.description: Name tags, badges, lanyards, rigid card printing systems, and access control software for personal identification and access management. These are manufactured using printing and software technologies and sold to organizations for employee and visitor identification.

products.name: Engraving Equipment and Solutions
products.description: Laser and mechanical engraving machines and related systems for marking and identification applications. These are manufactured using precision engineering and sold to industrial and commercial customers.

products.name: Microfluidic Solutions Products
products.description: Microfluidic solutions products for specialized identification and laboratory applications, produced using advanced manufacturing and material science techniques.

products.name: Logistics Real Estate Leasing
products.description: Leasing of high-quality logistics and industrial facilities to customers across global commercial hubs. Facilities are physically constructed, owned or managed by Prologis, and leased under operating leases with contractual terms.

products.name: Logistics Real Estate Development
products.description: Development of modern logistics and industrial facilities, including build-to-suit and speculative projects, for long-term hold or contribution to co-investment ventures. Involves physical construction, land procurement, and redevelopment activities.

products.name: Data Center Development and Leasing
products.description: Development and selective leasing of data centers, including conversion of logistics sites to energy-ready data center developments. Requires procurement of power, specialized construction, and leasing to customers with digital infrastructure needs.

products.name: Strategic Capital Management Services
products.description: Asset management, property management, and related services for co-investment ventures with institutional investors. Includes earning management fees, leasing, acquisition, construction management, and disposition services for third-party owned real estate assets.

products.name: Prologis Essentials Platform (Operational, Energy, and Sustainability Solutions)
products.description: Provision of operational, energy, and sustainability solutions to logistics facility customers, including LED lighting, solar generation, energy storage, EV charging, and other infrastructure products and services. Delivered through partnerships, proprietary technology, and in-house teams.

products.name: Machine Perception Software Solutions
products.description: Software solutions based on advanced machine learning algorithms for detecting and tracking persons and objects in video streams, primarily delivered to automotive and other OEM customers via licensing. These are digital-only products embedded into customer devices and systems.

products.name: Optical Touch and Gesture Sensing Technology Licensing
products.description: Licensing of patented optical sensing technologies (zForce platform) for touch, contactless touch, and gesture sensing, enabling OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers to embed these capabilities into their products. Delivery is via technology licensing, not physical manufacturing.

products.name: Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) Services
products.description: Specialized engineering services provided on a flat or hourly rate to support application development and integration of Neonode's technology into customer products, involving in-person human labor and technical expertise.

products.name: Advanced Instrumentation and Measurement Tools
products.description: Professional instruments used for maintenance, repair, measurement, and condition monitoring, manufactured and delivered physically to customers in industries such as manufacturing, process, healthcare, utilities, and electronics.

products.name: Facility and Asset Lifecycle Software
products.description: Software applications for managing facility and asset lifecycles, delivered digitally to customers in various verticals to enhance productivity, compliance, and sustainability.

products.name: Connected Worker Safety and Compliance Solutions
products.description: Digital and physical solutions, including software and devices, to ensure worker safety and regulatory compliance across industries, delivered through connected platforms and services.

products.name: Instrument Sterilization Solutions
products.description: Manufactured sterilization equipment and consumables for healthcare providers, ensuring instruments and operating rooms meet critical safety standards, delivered physically to healthcare facilities.

products.name: Instrument Tracking and Clinical Productivity Software
products.description: Digital software solutions for tracking medical instruments and managing clinical workflows, delivered to healthcare providers to improve efficiency and compliance.

products.name: Biomedical Test Tools and Radiation Safety Monitoring
products.description: Manufactured biomedical testing instruments and radiation detection devices, delivered physically to healthcare providers for equipment testing and safety monitoring.

products.name: Water Treatment Solutions
products.description: Formulates, manufactures, blends, and distributes chemicals, equipment, and services for potable water, municipal and industrial wastewater, industrial process water, swimming pools, and agricultural water. Delivered via a network of warehouses and route-based service technicians.

products.name: Industrial Chemicals and Ingredients
products.description: Manufactures, blends, repackages, and distributes bulk and specialty chemicals including acids, alkalis, salts, and food/pharmaceutical-grade ingredients to industrial customers in sectors such as agriculture, chemical processing, electronics, energy, food, pharmaceutical, and plating. Includes custom blending and repackaging services.

products.name: Health and Nutrition Ingredients and Solutions
products.description: Distributes, processes, and formulates minerals, vitamins, amino acids, botanicals, sweeteners, enzymes, and other ingredients for manufacturers of nutraceutical, functional food and beverage, personal care, dietary supplement, and health and wellness products. Offers value-added services such as formulation, sourcing, blending, and quality control.

products.name: Ficerafusp alfa (BCA101)
products.description: A bifunctional EGFR-directed monoclonal antibody fused to a TGF-β ligand trap, developed as an injectable biologic therapy for solid tumors, particularly squamous cell carcinomas. It is produced using recombinant DNA technology and delivered via infusion, requiring regulated manufacturing and clinical administration.

products.name: Organ Care System (OCS) Platform
products.description: A portable, FDA-approved, multi-organ warm perfusion technology platform for preserving, optimizing, and assessing donor organs (heart, lung, liver) outside the human body prior to transplantation. The system includes a console, single-use organ-specific disposable perfusion sets, and nutrient-enriched solutions, all manufactured and assembled by the company.

products.name: National OCS Program (NOP) Services
products.description: A turnkey, outsourced service for organ procurement, OCS perfusion management, and transplant logistics, including aviation and ground transportation, delivered by trained clinical staff and a dedicated logistics network. The NOP enables transplant centers to increase transplant volume without expanding internal resources.

products.name: Organ Transportation and Logistics Services
products.description: Comprehensive transportation services for donor organs, including 100% owned and operated private aircraft and ground vehicles, integrated into the NOP to ensure timely and safe delivery of organs nationwide. These services are provided directly to transplant centers as part of the organ procurement process.

products.name: OCS Solutions (Nutrient-Enriched Solutions)
products.description: Proprietary, nutrient-enriched perfusion solutions used with the OCS platform to replenish nutrients and hormones in donor organs during ex vivo preservation. These solutions are manufactured by third-party suppliers and are required for each organ transplant using the OCS.

products.name: Rifles
products.description: Rifles are long guns with spiral grooves in the barrel, manufactured in the U.S. using domestic materials and sold under the Ruger, Marlin, and Glenfield brands through wholesale distributors to commercial and law enforcement markets.

products.name: Pistols
products.description: Pistols are handguns with the ammunition chamber integral to the barrel, produced in U.S. facilities and sold under the Ruger brand to commercial, law enforcement, and export markets via distributors.

products.name: Revolvers
products.description: Revolvers are handguns with a rotating cylinder holding ammunition, manufactured in the U.S. and sold under the Ruger brand to commercial and law enforcement markets.

products.name: Shotguns
products.description: Shotguns are long guns with smooth barrels that fire pellets, manufactured in the U.S. and sold under the Ruger brand, primarily to the commercial sporting market.

products.name: Firearm Accessories and Replacement Parts
products.description: Accessories and replacement parts for Ruger firearms are manufactured and sold to external customers, supporting the use and maintenance of the company's firearms.

products.name: Investment Castings and Metal Injection Molded Parts
products.description: Investment castings and metal injection molded (MIM) parts are precision metal components produced using specialized casting and molding processes, sold to external customers in various industries in addition to internal use.

products.name: AI-Driven Size and Fit Technology Platform (Naiz Fit and ShoeSize.Me)
products.description: A B2B SaaS platform providing AI-powered size and fit recommendations, virtual try-on, AI stylist, fitting audits, sizing consistency analysis, and in-store phygital sizing tools for fashion and footwear brands. Delivered digitally and integrated into client e-commerce and retail environments.

products.name: E-Commerce Retailing and Overstock Management (Orgad)
products.description: Technology-enabled wholesale resale of fashion, footwear, and accessories as a third-party seller on Amazon, using proprietary software for inventory sourcing, pricing, and fulfillment. Products are physically sourced, warehoused, and sold via Amazon's logistics infrastructure.

products.name: Managed Second-Hand Fashion Recommerce Platform (Percentil)
products.description: A managed platform for collecting, processing, and reselling pre-owned fashion items, including B2C consignment and B2B circular solutions for brands. Involves physical garment intake, quality control, pricing, warehousing, and fulfillment, supported by proprietary technology.

products.name: International Apparel and Footwear Brand Distribution (Ten Peacks)
products.description: Marketing and distribution of global apparel and footwear brands in Israel, acting as a local distributor and commercial partner for international brands. Involves inventory purchasing or consignment, logistics, and wholesale/retail placement in the Israeli market.

products.name: IL13Rα2-Targeted CAR T Cell Therapy (MB-101)
products.description: A cell-based immunotherapy for glioblastoma and other high-grade brain tumors, manufactured by engineering patient T cells to express a chimeric antigen receptor targeting IL13Rα2. Production involves ex vivo T cell modification and expansion, followed by intracranial administration. Developed in partnership with City of Hope.

products.name: HSV-1 Oncolytic Virus Therapy (MB-108)
products.description: A genetically engineered herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) designed to selectively replicate in and destroy tumor cells, while stimulating an immune response against cancer. Manufactured using viral engineering and administered via stereotactic intracerebral injection. Developed in partnership with Nationwide Children’s Hospital.

products.name: Combination CAR T and Oncolytic Virus Therapy (MB-109)
products.description: A combination therapy integrating IL13Rα2-targeted CAR T cells (MB-101) and HSV-1 oncolytic virus (MB-108) for the treatment of relapsed or refractory glioblastoma and high-grade astrocytoma. Delivered via intratumoral and intraventricular administration, leveraging both cell therapy and viral immunotherapy platforms.

products.name: Gene Therapy for MYBPC3-associated Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy (TN-201)
products.description: An AAV9-based gene therapy delivered via single intravenous infusion to treat the underlying genetic cause of MYBPC3-associated hypertrophic cardiomyopathy by delivering a working MYBPC3 gene to heart cells. Requires advanced biologic manufacturing and regulated clinical delivery.

products.name: Gene Therapy for PKP2-associated Arrhythmogenic Right Ventricular Cardiomyopathy (TN-401)
products.description: An AAV9-based gene therapy administered as a single intravenous infusion to address the genetic cause of PKP2-associated ARVC by delivering a functional PKP2 gene to heart muscle cells. Involves complex biologic manufacturing and clinical administration.

products.name: HDAC6 Inhibitor Small Molecule Therapeutics (TN-301)
products.description: A highly selective small molecule inhibitor of HDAC6, administered orally, with potential to treat heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD), and other cardiac, metabolic, muscular, and pulmonary diseases. Requires chemical synthesis and regulated oral drug delivery.

products.name: Early-Stage Genetic Medicines for Heart Disease
products.description: A pipeline of preclinical programs using approaches such as cellular regeneration, gene addition, gene editing, and gene silencing to address rare and/or prevalent heart diseases. These are in early development and leverage advanced genetic and molecular technologies.

products.name: Research Collaboration and Target Discovery Services for Cardiovascular Disease
products.description: Collaborative research services to identify and validate novel gene targets for cardiovascular disease, leveraging proprietary discovery platforms and reimbursed by partners. Delivered as research and intellectual property licensing to external biopharma partners.

products.name: Truckload Transportation Services
products.description: Arranges full truckload freight transportation for customers using contracted motor carriers, leveraging proprietary technology for matching, tracking, and optimization. Delivery is coordinated through a network of carriers and managed digitally and by logistics professionals.

products.name: Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) Transportation Services
products.description: Provides LTL freight transportation, consolidating smaller shipments from multiple customers into full truckloads when possible, using contracted carriers and proprietary technology for visibility and management.

products.name: Ocean Freight Services
products.description: Acts as a licensed NVOCC and freight forwarder to arrange and consolidate international ocean shipments, select carriers, determine routing, and provide local pickup and delivery, using contracts with major ocean carriers.

products.name: Air Freight Services
products.description: Provides international and domestic air freight forwarding as a certified Indirect Air Carrier, organizing air shipments, arranging door-to-door service, and contracting with air carriers and charter services.

products.name: Customs Brokerage and Trade Compliance Services
products.description: Offers customs brokerage and trade compliance services to assist importers and exporters in meeting regulatory requirements, leveraging licensed customs brokers and proprietary technology for documentation and compliance.

products.name: Managed Solutions (3PL/4PL and Transportation Management)
products.description: Provides managed transportation solutions, including 3PL and 4PL services, transportation management system (TMS) technology, logistics consulting, optimization, and day-to-day logistics management, delivered through proprietary platforms and logistics experts.

products.name: Intermodal Transportation Services
products.description: Arranges intermodal freight transportation using a combination of truck and rail, coordinating container or trailer shipments across modes for efficiency and cost savings.

products.name: Warehousing and Value-Added Logistics Services
products.description: Offers warehousing, freight consolidation, crossdocking, drop trailer, transloading, and other value-added logistics services to optimize supply chains, reduce storage needs, and improve shipment efficiency.

products.name: Supply Chain Consulting and Analytics Services
products.description: Provides supply chain consulting, design, and analytics services to help customers optimize transportation rate structures, shipping modes, carrier selection, and overall supply chain performance, using proprietary data and technology.

products.name: Sourcing of Fresh Produce and Perishables (Robinson Fresh)
products.description: Sources, buys, sells, and markets fresh fruits, vegetables, and other value-added perishable items globally, including inventory forecasting, replenishment, and brand management, delivered to grocery retailers, restaurants, and wholesalers.

products.name: Senior Secured Lending
products.description: Provision of senior secured loans to leveraged middle-market companies, typically ranging from $5 million to $100 million per investment, originated and managed by in-house investment professionals. These loans are secured by company assets and require significant financial structuring and due diligence.

products.name: Asset-Based Lending
products.description: Asset-backed financing solutions for small-to-medium-sized businesses, where loans are secured by company assets such as receivables, inventory, or equipment. Delivered through subsidiaries like SLR Business Credit and SLR Credit Solutions, requiring specialized underwriting and collateral management.

products.name: Equipment Financing and Leasing
products.description: Provision of equipment financing and leasing solutions, primarily to large corporate clients, through subsidiaries such as SLR Equipment Finance and Kingsbridge Holdings. Involves physical asset evaluation, lease structuring, and ongoing asset management.

products.name: Healthcare Asset-Based Lending
products.description: Specialized asset-based lending to healthcare companies, including healthcare cash flow loans and life science loans, delivered through SLR Healthcare ABL. Requires industry-specific underwriting and regulatory expertise.

products.name: Unsecured and Subordinated Lending
products.description: Provision of unsecured and subordinated loans to middle-market companies, typically with higher yields and risk profiles than senior secured loans. These loans are structured with flexible terms and may include equity features.

products.name: Equity Investments in Portfolio Companies
products.description: Direct equity investments in portfolio companies, often as a minority interest or through warrants/options attached to debt investments. These are typically illiquid and require active portfolio management and exit planning.

products.name: Opportunistic Investments (including Public and Foreign Securities)
products.description: Investments in non-core opportunities such as securities of public companies (not thinly traded) and debt/equity of companies outside the U.S., intended to enhance overall returns. These are not the primary focus and are limited to a portion of the portfolio.

products.name: ORLADEYO (berotralstat)
products.description: An oral, once-daily small molecule serine protease inhibitor for the prevention of hereditary angioedema (HAE) attacks, manufactured and distributed globally via specialty pharmacy and commercial partners. Available in capsule and oral pellet formulations for adults and pediatric patients.

products.name: Navenibart (STAR-0215)
products.description: An injectable monoclonal antibody plasma kallikrein inhibitor in late-stage development for prophylactic treatment of hereditary angioedema (HAE), designed for infrequent administration (every 3-6 months) and manufactured using biologic processes.

products.name: Peramivir Injection (RAPIVAB, RAPIACTA, PERAMIFLU)
products.description: An intravenous neuraminidase inhibitor antiviral for the treatment of acute uncomplicated influenza, manufactured and supplied for use in the US, Japan, Korea, and other global markets, including government stockpiling contracts.

products.name: BCX17725
products.description: A protein therapeutic KLK5 inhibitor in early clinical development for Netherton syndrome, a rare genetic skin disorder; manufactured as a biologic and delivered systemically to restore skin barrier function.

products.name: Avoralstat (for Diabetic Macular Edema)
products.description: An investigational plasma kallikrein inhibitor delivered via suprachoroidal injection to the back of the eye for the treatment of diabetic macular edema, utilizing a proprietary microinjector device for targeted, long-lasting exposure.

products.name: STAR-0310
products.description: A monoclonal antibody OX40 antagonist incorporating half-life extension technology, in early clinical development for atopic dermatitis and potentially other immune-mediated conditions; manufactured as a biologic for infrequent administration.

products.name: Comprehensive Management Services for Aesthetic Clinics
products.description: Provision of end-to-end management services to franchisee and alliance aesthetic clinics, including advertising and marketing, staff recruitment and training, booking and reservation systems, employee housing and facility rentals, leasehold improvements and design, procurement of medical equipment and consumables, IT solutions (including remote consultations), customer loyalty program management, and payment tools. Delivered primarily through service contracts and franchise agreements, these services require in-person human labor, regulated infrastructure, and digital platforms.

products.name: Franchising and Brand Licensing for Aesthetic Clinics
products.description: Licensing of intellectual property, including brand names (e.g., 'Shonan Beauty Clinic'), trademarks, patents, and operational know-how to franchisee and independently operated clinics. This includes the right to use standardized procedures, proprietary technologies, and brand image, delivered via franchise and partner agreements. Revenue is generated through monthly royalties and franchise fees.

products.name: Procurement and Resale of Medical Equipment, Supplies, and Cosmetic Products
products.description: Acting as a purchasing agent, the company procures and resells medical devices, equipment (e.g., lasers, incubators), medical consumables (e.g., injectables, syringes), and cosmetic products (e.g., skincare, creams) to clinics for use and resale to end customers. This involves physical product sourcing, inventory management, and regulated distribution, primarily in Japan.

products.name: Direct Operation of Aesthetic and Medical Clinics
products.description: Ownership and direct operation of aesthetic clinics in Singapore and Vietnam, providing surgical and non-surgical cosmetic medical services (e.g., cosmetic surgery, dermatology, dentistry) to end customers. Delivery requires regulated clinical infrastructure, licensed medical professionals, and in-person services.

products.name: Medical Consulting and Operational Support Services for Medical Institutions
products.description: Provision of consulting and operational support services to medical institutions, including management consulting, operational process support, marketing, procurement, HR and recruitment, information system management, and business analysis. Delivered through service contracts, these services require specialized human expertise and digital tools.

products.name: Rental and Lease Services for Medical Facilities and Equipment
products.description: Rental of medical equipment and operating leases for clinic facilities to franchisee clinics and medical corporations. This includes leasehold improvements, facility design, and coordination with contractors. Delivery involves physical assets and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Customer Loyalty Program Management Services
products.description: Management of customer rewards and loyalty point programs for clinics, including points accrual, redemption, and tiered benefits for end customers. Delivered via digital platforms and integrated with clinic operations, this service supports customer retention and marketing.

products.name: Licensing of Medical Simulation and Training Technologies
products.description: Licensing of proprietary simulation technologies, including AI-based and virtual reality simulators, to clinics for staff training, procedural standardization, and remote consultation. Delivered digitally, these technologies enhance clinical education and operational consistency.

products.name: Merchandise Freight Rail Transportation
products.description: Rail-based transportation of diverse merchandise including chemicals, agricultural and food products, automotive, minerals, forest products, metals and equipment, and fertilizers, delivered via a 20,000 route-mile rail network and supported by physical rail infrastructure and regulated operations.

products.name: Intermodal Transportation Services
products.description: Transportation of intermodal containers and trailers combining rail and truck modes, utilizing a network of approximately 30 terminals to move mainly manufactured consumer goods in containers, offering truck-like service for longer shipments.

products.name: Coal and Bulk Commodity Rail Transportation
products.description: Rail transportation of coal, coke, and iron ore to domestic electricity-generating power plants, steel manufacturers, industrial plants, and export coal to port facilities, requiring specialized rail equipment and regulated infrastructure.

products.name: Bulk Liquid Chemicals Truck Transportation
products.description: Trucking transportation services for bulk liquid chemicals, primarily provided by Quality Carriers, involving a large fleet of specialized tank trucks and drivers operating across North America.

products.name: Automotive Distribution and Storage Services
products.description: Distribution and storage services for the automotive industry, including management of distribution centers and storage locations, primarily delivered through Total Distribution Services, Inc. (TDSI).

products.name: Rail-to-Truck Transfer Services
products.description: Transfer of products from railcars to trucks for customers not directly served by rail, primarily through TRANSFLO Terminal Services, involving specialized terminal operations and handling of commodities such as chemicals and agriculture products.

products.name: Regional Subsidiary Railroad Services
products.description: Freight rail transportation services provided by regional subsidiary railroads that CSX does not directly operate, leveraging local rail infrastructure and connections to the broader CSX network.

products.name: Intermodal Storage and Equipment Usage Services
products.description: Provision of storage for intermodal containers at terminals or offsite locations and rental of equipment, generating revenue through storage and usage fees.

products.name: Railcar Demurrage and Switching Services
products.description: Ancillary rail services including demurrage (charges for holding freight cars beyond a specified period) and switching (moving cars for customers or other railroads), delivered as part of regulated rail operations.

products.name: Sulfide-Based Solid Electrolyte Material
products.description: A sulfide-based solid electrolyte material produced using batch and continuous manufacturing processes, supplied to battery manufacturers and automotive OEMs for use in solid-state battery cells. Production involves industrial-scale chemical synthesis and process engineering, with pilot and planned commercial-scale facilities.

products.name: Licensing of Cell Manufacturing Processes and Cell Designs
products.description: Licensing of proprietary solid-state battery cell manufacturing processes and cell designs to battery manufacturers and OEMs, enabling partners to produce solid-state cells using Solid Power's technology. Delivery is via technology transfer, documentation, and support, not physical manufacturing.

products.name: Polymetallic Nodules
products.description: Raw polymetallic nodules collected from the seafloor in the Clarion Clipperton Zone, containing high concentrations of nickel, copper, cobalt, manganese, and rare earth elements. Collection requires specialized offshore mining vessels and remotely operated collector vehicles, followed by transport to onshore processing facilities.

products.name: Nickel Products (including Nickel Cathode and Nickel Sulfate)
products.description: Nickel-bearing intermediate and refined products produced from processed polymetallic nodules, including nickel cathode and battery-grade nickel sulfate. Production involves pyrometallurgical and hydrometallurgical processing at onshore facilities, either in-house or via tolling partners.

products.name: Copper Products (including Copper Cathode)
products.description: Copper-bearing intermediate and refined products derived from polymetallic nodules, including copper cathode. Produced through onshore processing and refining, using both pyrometallurgical and hydrometallurgical methods.

products.name: Cobalt Products (including Cobalt Cathode and Cobalt Sulfate)
products.description: Cobalt-bearing intermediate and refined products from processed nodules, including cobalt cathode and battery-grade cobalt sulfate. Produced at onshore facilities using advanced metallurgical flowsheets.

products.name: Manganese Silicate Product
products.description: A manganese silicate product (~40% manganese), comparable to medium-grade manganese ore, produced from polymetallic nodules via pyrometallurgical processing at onshore facilities. Used primarily in steel manufacturing and other industrial applications.

products.name: Nickel-Copper-Cobalt Matte and Alloy Intermediates
products.description: Intermediate alloy and matte products containing nickel, copper, and cobalt, produced from nodules as part of the processing chain before final refining into pure metals or battery-grade chemicals. These intermediates are shipped to refineries for further processing.

products.name: Silicomanganese Alloy
products.description: A potential future product, silicomanganese alloy, produced from processed nodules, used in steelmaking and industrial applications. Production would require additional refining steps at onshore facilities.

products.name: Battery-Grade Sulfates and Precursor Cathode Active Materials (pCAM)
products.description: Potential future products including battery-grade nickel, cobalt, and manganese sulfates, and precursor cathode active materials (pCAM) for use in lithium-ion battery manufacturing. Production would involve advanced hydrometallurgical refining and partnerships with battery material specialists.

products.name: Rare Earth Elements (REE) Products
products.description: Potential future extraction and sale of rare earth elements contained in polymetallic nodules, for use in high-tech and strategic applications. Would require specialized processing and refining capabilities beyond current operations.

products.name: Quantum Computing Systems (Entropy Quantum Computer - EQC)
products.description: Quantum computing machines based on integrated photonics technology, designed for complex optimization problems, available as both cloud-based services and on-premises hardware. These systems are physically manufactured and leverage proprietary photonic architectures for room-temperature, low-power operation.

products.name: Artificial Intelligence Edge Devices (Reservoir Computing Machines)
products.description: Hardware-based AI edge devices, such as the Emucore and Neurawave reservoir computers, optimized for recurrent neural network applications and time-dependent tasks, delivered as standalone physical devices for local data processing without internet connectivity.

products.name: TFLN Optical Chips and Photonic Integrated Circuits
products.description: Custom thin film lithium niobate (TFLN) optical chips and photonic integrated circuits, including single photon detectors, electro-optical modulators, and frequency conversion devices, manufactured at the company's foundry and sold to commercial markets for use in optical devices and quantum information processing.

products.name: LiDAR Systems
products.description: Photonics-based LiDAR systems utilizing patented spatial-temporal mode methodologies for high-resolution, long-distance imaging and measurement in challenging environments, physically manufactured for deployment on aircraft, drones, and satellites.

products.name: Quantum Photonic Vibrometers
products.description: Remote vibration detection and sensing instruments using quantum photonic technology for high-sensitivity, high-speed, and high-resolution measurement of vibration spectra in solid or liquid targets, delivered as physical devices for industrial and scientific applications.

products.name: Quantum Network and Authentication Solutions
products.description: Quantum authentication and secure communication systems leveraging quantum mechanics-based methodologies to eliminate third-party key distribution, delivered as network security solutions for private communications.

products.name: Photonics Semiconductor Components and Modules
products.description: Advanced photonics semiconductor components, modules, subsystems, and systems, including laser diodes, optical amplifiers, photonic integrated circuits, and related chips, designed and manufactured for integration into customer products across industries such as aerospace, defense, sensing, and optical communications.

products.name: Foundry Services for Photonic Chip Prototyping and Manufacturing
products.description: Contract manufacturing and prototyping services for custom photonic chips and integrated circuits, leveraging in-house facilities for research, development, and small-batch to higher volume production for external customers.

products.name: Medical Urgent Care Services
products.description: Provision of 24/7 urgent medical care, including medical assistance, evacuation, and coordination, delivered through a proprietary digital platform integrating AI and ML for rapid triage and diagnosis. Services are accessible via mobile application and supported by a network of medical partners.

products.name: Digital Health Platform and Telehealth Services
products.description: A proprietary digital platform offering teleconsultations, e-triage, digital medical certificates, and remote patient monitoring, leveraging AI/ML for diagnostics, analytics, and care coordination. Delivered via web and mobile applications to both individual and corporate clients.

products.name: Property Management and Home Care Services
products.description: Management of residential and commercial properties, including common area and security management, with an evolving focus on integrating home-based medical and care services such as remote monitoring, chronic disease management, and post-surgery care. Delivered through contracts with property owners and associations.

products.name: Digital Health Marketplace (DHM)
products.description: An online e-commerce platform specializing in health and wellness products, including dietary supplements, skincare, and healthy snacks. The marketplace uses AI to assist users in product selection and offers both on-demand and subscription-based purchasing options.

products.name: Health and Wellness Subscription Plans
products.description: Monthly subscription packages for corporations and individuals, covering a selection of telehealth services such as teleconsultation, online pharmacy, and health screenings. Delivered digitally via the EUDA platform.

products.name: Chronic Disease Management Services
products.description: Digital and in-person services for the management of chronic diseases, including remote monitoring, continuous care management, and preventative services, integrated into the EUDA platform and home care offerings.

products.name: Mental Health and Behavioral Health Services
products.description: Access to mental health support, including digital connections to therapists and psychologists, and behavioral health programs for conditions such as anxiety and smoking cessation, delivered via the EUDA platform.

products.name: Fitness and Wellness Content Services
products.description: Provision of digital fitness modules, customizable fitness plans, and wellness content (including men’s and women’s health), accessible through the EUDA platform and in partnership with fitness providers.

products.name: Data Streaming Platform
products.description: A comprehensive platform that enables organizations to stream, connect, process, and govern real-time data across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. Delivered as a fully-managed SaaS (Confluent Cloud), self-managed software (Confluent Platform), private cloud solution (Confluent Private Cloud), or BYOC managed service (Confluent WarpStream), it integrates open source technologies like Apache Kafka and Flink, and includes connectors, governance, and processing capabilities.

products.name: Stream Processing Services (Apache Flink)
products.description: Managed and self-managed stream processing services based on Apache Flink, enabling real-time data transformation, analytics, and enrichment. Delivered as a serverless cloud service or as part of on-premises deployments, these services allow customers to build and scale stream processing applications for real-time business logic and analytics.

products.name: Data Connectors and Integration Services
products.description: A portfolio of over 120 pre-built and custom connectors that integrate data from and to various systems, applications, and databases, enabling seamless data movement and integration across enterprise environments. Delivered as part of the Data Streaming Platform and available for cloud, on-premises, and hybrid deployments.

products.name: Stream Governance Suite
products.description: A suite of data governance tools purpose-built for data streaming, including schema management, metadata, data contracts, cataloging, lineage, and compliance features. Available as a fully managed service or self-managed software, it ensures data quality, security, and regulatory compliance for real-time data streams.

products.name: Tableflow (Streaming Data to Analytics)
products.description: A managed service that materializes streaming data directly into open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) for use in data warehouses, data lakes, and analytics engines. Automates data ingestion, schematization, and table maintenance, enabling real-time analytics and AI workloads.

products.name: Confluent Intelligence (AI Data Services)
products.description: A suite of managed features and services that deliver real-time, context-rich data to AI systems and applications, including real-time context engines, streaming agents, and built-in machine learning functions. Enables organizations to build event-driven AI agents and power generative AI applications with trustworthy, up-to-date data.

products.name: Professional Services
products.description: Consulting and implementation services that provide expertise and tools to help customers accelerate adoption, migration, architecture design, and performance tuning of Confluent’s platform. Delivered by Confluent experts to ensure successful business outcomes and operational excellence.

products.name: Education and Training Services
products.description: Training, certification, and educational resources for customers and developers, including instructor-led courses, self-paced learning, and certification exams. Designed to support user adoption and proficiency with Confluent’s technologies.

products.name: Banking Services
products.description: Provision of traditional banking services, including deposit accounts and lending, through physical branches and interstate branch networks. Services are delivered via regulated infrastructure and require regulatory approvals.

products.name: Household and Specialty Batteries
products.description: Manufactures and distributes a wide range of primary, rechargeable, specialty, and hearing aid batteries using technologies such as lithium, alkaline, carbon zinc, nickel metal hydride, zinc air, and silver oxide. Products are produced in company facilities and sold globally under multiple brands.

products.name: Auto Care Products
products.description: Produces and markets automotive appearance, fragrance, performance, and air conditioning recharge products, including protectants, wipes, tire and wheel care, glass cleaners, air fresheners, fuel and oil additives, functional fluids, refrigerants, and recharge kits. Products are manufactured and distributed under various brands and require regulated chemical handling and packaging.

products.name: Portable Lighting Products
products.description: Designs, manufactures, and distributes handheld, headlamps, lanterns, and area lights for consumer and industrial use. Products are produced using various materials and technologies and sold under multiple brands worldwide.

products.name: Brand Licensing for Consumer Power and Lighting Solutions
products.description: Licenses Energizer, Eveready, and Rayovac brands to third parties for use on consumer solutions such as solar products, automotive batteries, portable power for critical devices, generators, power tools, and household light bulbs. This is a brand extension business rather than direct manufacturing.

products.name: Manufacturing Data Analytics and AI Platform
products.description: A comprehensive software platform (Exensio) providing real-time analytics, AI/ML-driven insights, and visualization for semiconductor manufacturing, test, and assembly data. Delivered as on-premise licenses or SaaS, it integrates data from multiple sources to optimize yield, quality, and operational efficiency.

products.name: Manufacturing Data Integration and Orchestration Software
products.description: Software (Sapience) for integrating, aggregating, and streaming manufacturing equipment data across diverse protocols and systems, enabling enterprise-level applications, real-time insights, and digital transformation. Delivered as a cloud-native platform and enterprise integration hub.

products.name: E-Beam Inspection Systems
products.description: DirectScan system combining proprietary eProbe hardware and software for non-contact, high-throughput e-beam inspection of semiconductor devices, identifying systematic failures inline. Delivered as hardware sales or license/lease, with analysis services included.

products.name: Parametric Characterization and Yield Improvement Systems
products.description: Characterization Vehicle (CV) system comprising custom test chips, electrical test hardware, analysis software, and related services to accelerate yield learning and process optimization in semiconductor manufacturing. Includes design, testing, and data analysis services.

products.name: Equipment Connectivity and Control Software
products.description: Cimetrix software suite enabling equipment manufacturers to implement industry-standard connectivity, control, and data collection interfaces for semiconductor and electronics manufacturing equipment. Delivered as SDKs, runtime licenses, and control frameworks supporting SEMI standards.

products.name: Secure Remote Equipment Connectivity and Monitoring Systems
products.description: secureWISE system providing secure, end-to-end remote connectivity, monitoring, and access for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, including proprietary software, dedicated hardware, and a managed private network. Enables equipment suppliers and fabs to manage equipment health and support remotely.

products.name: Professional and Engineering Services for Manufacturing Data Solutions
products.description: A suite of services including software/hardware installation, configuration, system/data integration, test chip design, data cleaning, analytics, and value realization, delivered by experienced engineers to support and optimize customer use of the company's products and platforms.

products.name: Software Maintenance and Technical Support Services
products.description: Ongoing maintenance, technical support, and repair services for the company's software and hardware products, including updates, troubleshooting, and warranty support, provided globally to ensure customer uptime and satisfaction.

products.name: Action Figures and Accessories
products.description: Manufactured physical toys including action figures and related accessories, often based on licensed entertainment properties or proprietary brands, produced via third-party manufacturing and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Toy Vehicles
products.description: Physical toy vehicles such as trucks, cars, and remote-control toys, produced under both proprietary and licensed brands, manufactured overseas and distributed to retailers and wholesalers.

products.name: Dolls and Accessories
products.description: Manufactured dolls of various sizes and types, including fashion, baby, and character dolls, based on licensed properties and proprietary brands, produced overseas and sold through retail and e-commerce.

products.name: Private Label Toy and Consumer Products
products.description: Custom-developed toy and consumer product lines manufactured exclusively for specific retail customers, leveraging proprietary and licensed designs, produced via third-party manufacturing.

products.name: Ride-On Toys and Inflatable Play Environments
products.description: Physical ride-on toys and inflatable play structures, including branded and licensed products, manufactured overseas and distributed to retailers and wholesalers.

products.name: Role Play, Dress-Up, and Pretend Play Products
products.description: Physical toys and accessories for role play, dress-up, and pretend play, including items based on licensed entertainment properties and proprietary brands, manufactured and distributed globally.

products.name: Kids’ Furniture and Room Décor
products.description: Manufactured indoor and outdoor furniture, activity tables, trays, and room décor for children, often featuring licensed characters, produced overseas and distributed through retail channels.

products.name: Costumes and Costume Accessories
products.description: Manufactured costumes and related accessories for Halloween and everyday use, for children, teens, and adults, based on licensed and proprietary brands, produced via third-party manufacturing and distributed globally.

products.name: Outdoor Activity and Sports Toys
products.description: Physical toys for outdoor play and junior sports, including skateboards, balls, sport sets, and hoops, produced under proprietary and licensed brands, manufactured overseas and distributed to retailers.

products.name: Board Games
products.description: Manufactured board games under proprietary brands, produced overseas and distributed through retail and e-commerce channels.

products.name: Natural Gas Pipeline Transportation Services
products.description: DT Midstream provides transportation of natural gas through its network of interstate and intrastate pipelines, connecting production areas to demand centers, power plants, local distribution companies, industrial end users, and LNG export terminals. These services are delivered via physical, regulated pipeline infrastructure and are typically sold under long-term firm or interruptible contracts.

products.name: Natural Gas Gathering Services
products.description: DT Midstream collects natural gas from production wells using gathering systems, which include networks of pipelines, compression, dehydration, and treatment facilities. These services aggregate gas from producers and deliver it to processing plants or pipelines for further transportation, relying on extensive physical infrastructure and in-person operations.

products.name: Natural Gas Storage Services
products.description: DT Midstream provides storage of natural gas for customers using underground storage facilities, allowing customers to balance supply and demand. These services are delivered through regulated, physical storage complexes with associated compression infrastructure.

products.name: Ancillary Gathering Services (Compression, Dehydration, Gas Treatment, Water Services, Sand Mining)
products.description: DT Midstream offers ancillary services associated with natural gas gathering, including compression, dehydration, gas treatment, water impoundment, water transportation, water disposal, and sand mining. These services support the efficient and compliant movement of natural gas from wellhead to pipeline and are delivered via specialized physical facilities and equipment.

products.name: Cementing Services and Products
products.description: Bonding the well and well casing, isolating fluid zones, and maximizing wellbore stability through cementing services and provision of casing equipment. Requires physical manufacturing, specialized equipment, and in-person labor at well sites.

products.name: Completion Tools and Services
products.description: Provision of downhole solutions and services for well completion, including intelligent well completions, liner hanger systems, sand control systems, multilateral systems, and service tools. Delivered via specialized equipment and field services.

products.name: Artificial Lift Solutions
products.description: Services and products to maximize reservoir and wellbore recovery using lifting technology, intelligent field management, and electrical submersible pumps. Involves physical equipment installation and ongoing service.

products.name: Specialty Chemicals and Flow Assurance
products.description: Customized specialty chemicals and services for completion, production, midstream, and downstream operations to optimize flow assurance and integrity. Involves chemical manufacturing and field application.

products.name: Pipeline and Process Services
products.description: Pre-commissioning, commissioning, maintenance, and decommissioning services for onshore and offshore pipeline and process plant construction and maintenance. Delivered through specialized equipment and field teams.

products.name: Production Enhancement Services
products.description: Stimulation services (hydraulic fracturing, acidizing) and sand control services to optimize reservoir production. Requires pressure pumping equipment, chemical processes, and field operations.

products.name: Well Intervention and Production Solutions
products.description: Customized well intervention solutions to increase well performance, including coiled tubing, hydraulic workover units, downhole tools, pumping, and nitrogen services. Delivered via specialized equipment and skilled field personnel.

products.name: Drilling Fluid Systems and Waste Management
products.description: Provision of drilling fluid systems, performance additives, completion fluids, solids control, specialized testing equipment, and waste management services for drilling, completion, and workover operations. Involves chemical manufacturing, logistics, and on-site service.

products.name: Drill Bits and Downhole Tools
products.description: Manufacture and supply of roller cone bits, fixed cutter bits, hole enlargement tools, and coring equipment for drilling wells, including related downhole services. Requires physical manufacturing and field deployment.

products.name: Integrated Project Management and Asset Management
products.description: Integrated solutions leveraging well construction, completion, and intervention services to manage projects and assets throughout the well lifecycle. Involves project management expertise and coordination of multiple service lines.

products.name: Digital Software and Cloud Services for Energy
products.description: Cloud-based digital services and artificial intelligence solutions for subsurface insights, integrated well construction, and reservoir and production management. Delivered as software and digital platforms.

products.name: Directional Drilling and Wellbore Placement Services
products.description: Drilling systems and services for directional and horizontal drilling, measurement-while-drilling, logging-while-drilling, surface data logging, and rig site information systems. Delivered via advanced equipment and skilled personnel at drilling sites.

products.name: Well Testing and Subsea Safety Systems
products.description: Acquisition and analysis of dynamic reservoir information, well testing tools, fluid sampling, surface well testing, subsea safety systems, and managed pressure drilling solutions. Involves specialized equipment and field operations, including subsea deployments.

products.name: Wireline Logging and Perforating Services
products.description: Open-hole and cased-hole logging services for formation evaluation, reservoir fluid analysis, perforating, pipe recovery, through-casing evaluation, and well intervention. Delivered via wireline equipment and field crews.

products.name: Oil and Natural Gas Royalty Interests
products.description: Ownership and administration of mineral, royalty, overriding royalty, net profits, and leasehold interests in producing and non-producing oil and natural gas properties. Revenue is generated by receiving royalty payments based on production from these properties, which are managed and operated by third-party operators. This business line does not involve direct physical extraction or operation, but rather the management and acquisition of royalty interests, which are financial interests in the production of oil and natural gas.
